description: Na₂TiSi₄O₁₁ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/m space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.71 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There is one shorter (1.93 Å) and five longer (2.02 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 41°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.65 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in an octahedral geometry to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms.
